latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-skill-minimax-tracker.

- Provides real-time tracking of MiniMax API prompt usage for OpenClaw.
- Displays a visual progress bar with clear usage metrics.
- Calculates and displays reset and next reminder times.
- Supports command-line operations for adding usage and viewing status.
- Stores all usage data in JSON for persistence between runs.
- Includes cron-compatible reminder instructions and configuration guidance.
